question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Enigmatic
solution:
The correct answer is **"Comprehensible."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Enigmatic"** means mysterious or puzzling. (पहेलीनुमा, रहस्‍यमय, पेचीदा)

 
 
• **Example:** *The Mona Lisa has a famously **enigmatic**__ smile.*
 
 
 
• **"Comprehensible"** means understandable or clear. (समझने में आसान, सरल-सुबोध)
 __
 
• **Example:*** The book is written in clear, **comprehensible**__ language.*
 
 
 
• ​The most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word is **"Comprehensible."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cryptic** means having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure.
 
• **Tangible** means something that can be touched or felt, and is not related to Enigmatic.
 
• **Ambiguous **means having more than one possible interpretation or meaning.
